duty.quote: If information or ideas are obtained from any source (including GenAI), those sources must be acknowledged according to the appropriate convention in that subject

contents.quote: Where the use of AI is permitted, it must be verified and appropriately referenced in the work for transparency, with details of how it was used being provided.

consequence.quote: Any failure to acknowledge adequately or to cite properly other sources in submitted work is plagiarism.
